correctness.rationale: Each incidence check meets four variables. For a column stopping set S, complement T in dual PG(2,3) cannot meet any line in exactly three points. If no full dual line is contained, T is an arc and elementary even-parity argument forbids five-point arcs. If T contains full line L, affine U=T minus L has closure property: pair implies all three affine collinear points; hence U is empty, singleton, a full affine line or whole affine plane. These disjoint geometric cases count all 769 stopping sets and nine projective orbits. Every nonempty S contains complement of union of two lines, i.e. a 6-column minimum, yielding exact failure criterion. Independently reconstructed all 8192 incidence masks from F_3^3, computed stopping and iterative peeling, found 769 stopping, exactly same coefficients, 3004 failures; independently enumerated PGL(3,3) of order 5616 and verified all nine orbits. Correct for this H only.
